// Scratch generator: byte-level mutations of the transactions in the EIP-712 body corpus, judged by Accumulate itself:
// does Transaction.UnmarshalBinary accept the bytes, what is the transaction hash, and what does protocol.EIP712Hash say.
package main

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"os"

	"gitlab.com/accumulatenetwork/accumulate/protocol"
)

type Vector struct {
	ID          string `json:"id"`
	Transaction string `json:"transaction"`
	Signature   string `json:"signature"`
}
type In struct {
	Vectors []Vector `json:"vectors"`
}

type Mut struct {
	ID          string `json:"id"`
	Base        string `json:"base"`
	Op          string `json:"op"`
	Transaction string `json:"transaction"`
	Decodes     bool   `json:"decodes"`
	TxHash      string `json:"txHash,omitempty"`
	Hash        string `json:"hash,omitempty"`
	Refused     bool   `json:"refused,omitempty"`
}

type Out struct {
	Format      string `json:"format"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
	Accumulate  string `json:"accumulate"`
	Mutations   []Mut  `json:"mutations"`
}

func judge(tb []byte, sig protocol.Signature) (m Mut, ok bool) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			ok = false
		}
	}()
	txn := new(protocol.Transaction)
	if err := txn.UnmarshalBinary(tb); err != nil {
		return Mut{Decodes: false}, true
	}
	m.Decodes = true
	m.TxHash = hex.EncodeToString(txn.GetHash())
	h, err := protocol.EIP712Hash(txn, sig)
	if err != nil {
		m.Refused = true
	} else {
		m.Hash = hex.EncodeToString(h)
	}
	return m, true
}

func main() {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var in In
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &in); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	out := &Out{
		Format:      "certen:eip712-tx-mutations:v1",
		Description: "Byte-level mutations of the transactions in eip712-bodies.json (bit flip, byte replace, delete, insert, truncate, append), each judged by Accumulate: whether Transaction.UnmarshalBinary accepts the bytes, the transaction hash, and protocol.EIP712Hash under the base vector's signature. A mutation on which Go panics is not recorded.",
		Accumulate:  "gitlab.com/accumulatenetwork/accumulate v1.4.7-0.20260926030013-e1d1db9ebb7c",
	}
	panics := 0
	for _, v := range in.Vectors {
		raw, _ := hex.DecodeString(v.Transaction)
		sb, _ := hex.DecodeString(v.Signature)
		sig, err := protocol.UnmarshalSignature(sb)
		if err != nil || len(raw) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		r := rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(len(v.ID))*104729 + int64(len(raw)) + int64(raw[0])))
		for k := 0; k < 10; k++ {
			m := append([]byte(nil), raw...)
			op := ""
			switch k % 6 {
			case 0:
				i := r.Intn(len(m))
				m[i] ^= 1 << uint(r.Intn(8))
				op = fmt.Sprintf("flip@%d", i)
			case 1:
				i := r.Intn(len(m))
				m[i] = byte(r.Intn(256))
				op = fmt.Sprintf("set@%d", i)
			case 2:
				i := r.Intn(len(m))
				m = append(m[:i], m[i+1:]...)
				op = fmt.Sprintf("del@%d", i)
			case 3:
				i := r.Intn(len(m) + 1)
				m = append(m[:i], append([]byte{byte(r.Intn(256))}, m[i:]...)...)
				op = fmt.Sprintf("ins@%d", i)
			case 4:
				i := 1 + r.Intn(len(m))
				m = m[:i]
				op = fmt.Sprintf("trunc@%d", i)
			case 5:
				m = append(m, byte(1+r.Intn(31)), byte(r.Intn(4)))
				op = "append"
			}
			res, ok := judge(m, sig)
			if !ok {
				panics++
				continue
			}
			res.ID = fmt.Sprintf("%s#%02d", v.ID, k)
			res.Base = v.ID
			res.Op = op
			res.Transaction = hex.EncodeToString(m)
			out.Mutations = append(out.Mutations, res)
		}
	}
	j, _ := json.Marshal(out)
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], j, 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	dec, ref, hashed := 0, 0, 0
	for _, m := range out.Mutations {
		if m.Decodes {
			dec++
		}
		if m.Refused {
			ref++
		}
		if m.Hash != "" {
			hashed++
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("mutations", len(out.Mutations), "panics", panics, "decode", dec, "refused", ref, "digest", hashed)
}
